---
title: "Southern States US Senate Results by County"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

This interactive map displays county-level results for the most recent US Senate general election across the Southern states. Hover over or click any county to view the candidate, winning party, vote counts, and percentage.

```{r}
#| label: southern-counties-senate-map

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(maps)
library(leaflet)

# Load county Senate results (no API key required)
county_winners <- readRDS("data/southern_senate_county_results.rds") |>
  mutate(fips = as.integer(county_fips))

# Load standard FIPS-to-polygon lookup
data(county.fips, package = "maps")

# Build county boundaries joined with election data
counties_sf <- st_as_sf(maps::map("county", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE)) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(base_id = str_remove(ID, ":.*$")) |>
  inner_join(county.fips, by = c("base_id" = "polyname")) |>
  inner_join(county_winners, by = "fips")

# Get state boundary outlines for context
states_sf <- st_as_sf(maps::map("state", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE)) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  filter(ID %in% tolower(unique(county_winners$state)))

# Color palette for winning party
party_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("Republican" = "#E63946", "Democrat" = "#1D3557", "Other" = "#A8DADC"),
  domain = counties_sf$winning_party
)

# Render interactive leaflet map
leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = counties_sf,
    fillColor = ~party_pal(winning_party),
    weight = 0.5,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "#888888",
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    label = ~paste0(
      county_name, " County, ", state, " (", year, "): ", 
      winning_candidate, " (", winning_party, ", ", winning_pct, "%)"
    ),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", county_name, " County, ", state, "</strong><br/>",
      "Election Year: ", year, "<br/>",
      "Winner: ", winning_candidate, " (", winning_party, ")<br/>",
      "Winning Votes: ", scales::comma(winning_votes), " / ", scales::comma(total_votes), 
      " (", winning_pct, "%)"
    ),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2, 
      color = "#222222", 
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = states_sf,
    fill = FALSE,
    weight = 1.8,
    color = "#333333"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = party_pal,
    values = counties_sf$winning_party,
    title = "Winning Party",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
